Occurrences.Kwic: 進云：「如何過得這重關？」師云：「問取把關吏。」進云：「葉落歸根時如何道？」師云：「倒拔石頭根萬丈，玲瓏八角勢排雲。」僧問：「解結即不問，如何是衲僧向上事？」師云：「何不向下會？」進云：「向下事又作麼生？」師云：「井底蝦蟆飛上天。」師乃云：「他弓莫把，他馬莫騎，一線直路，不許人知。諸兄弟！清心禪堂是箇繫驢橛、祖師公案是箇葛藤椿、四海禪和是一緉破草鞋、天下善知識是一味斷腸草，直須斫倒繫驢橛，莊嚴無邊樓閣；拽斷葛藤樁，湧出義海詞峰。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J27/J27nB198.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Xueguan: Xueguan Zhiyin utters the headword-bearing wording.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師云：「鐘鼓交參，人天畢集，新年頭佛法作麼商量？」豎拂，云：「會麼？三界惟心，萬法惟識，剎竿頭上風車子，三個猢猻夜簸錢。至道無難，惟嫌揀擇，夜半石人無影象，縱橫誰辨往來源？但莫憎愛，洞然明白，井底蝦蟆吞卻月，三更不惜夜明簾。今日山僧為諸仁者斬斷繩頭，汝等會得，則世、出世間如大鵬金翅鳥，劈海吞龍，毫無隔礙，乃至山河大地、僧俗男女、貧富貴賤，總在汝等自心發現。蓋因爾等循業昧己，障蔽本有光明，故
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J33/J33nB286.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yingningjing: Yingning Jing utters the headword-bearing wording.

Senses.Explanation: The frog at the bottom of a well performs impossible actions: Baima Ai makes it swallow the moon, while Xueguan Zhiyin makes it fly into the sky. Later masters raise and verse the image as a deliberately cramped scene whose action exceeds its setting. Complete-unit reading distinguishes original utterance, later raising, verse/commentary, biography, and paratext, and groups duplicate recensions as related occurrences.

Senses.Note: The displayed sense is bounded by the stored exact uses; related compounds and quoted formulas were not allowed to create additional headword depth.

Senses.Explanation: To accord with the working is for a response to fit the presiding figure's live demand; the same word labels a verse presented at such a breakthrough. Biographies introduce 'accord-with-the-working verses', while addresses contrast verbal timing with genuine fit.

Senses.PreferredTarget: when chasing someone, do not catch up
AlternateTargets: drive him off without pursuing him down
SearchAliases: do not catch up while chasing
Senses.Note: An unnamed interlocutor presses Dahui with the pursuit line; Xutang separately uses the wording to halt pursuit of a case and to answer a question about locating the deceased.

Occurrences.Kwic: 住住。趕人不得趕上。次日上堂。有一人。日銷萬兩黃金。同此聖制。只是無人認得。若有人認得。却許伊。日銷萬兩黃金。上堂。舉。五洩初參石頭。洩云。一言相契即住。不契即去。頭據坐。洩便行。頭云。闍梨。洩回首。頭云。從生至老只是者箇。回頭轉腦作甚麼。洩於言下大悟。師云。稛載而往。垂橐而歸。上堂。舉。巖頭示眾。大凡唱教須從無欲中流出三句。只是理論咬去咬住欲去不去欲住不住。或時一向不去。或時一向不住。應庵拈云。從上老漢。須得箇些子說話。師云。巖頭若行一丈。應庵只行八尺
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n2000.xml). Xutang Sayings (虛堂和尚語錄). Speaker: Xutang Zhiyu.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師云。趕人不得趕上。僧云。莫是向不生不滅處去麼。師云。爾莫要撩撥者氣鼓老僧。僧云。他觸著便三毒起。師云。多少人仰望不及。僧云。洞山遷化。設愚癡齋。承天遷化。有何分付。師云。有分付。僧云。有甚分付。師云。教爾近前退後牢記話頭。僧云。也是不惜口業漢。師乃云。遠之莫及故曰短。蹤之不即故曰蓬。波波浪浪。西西東東。直鉤已掛雙峨碧。一橈香散蘆花風。解夏小參。僧問。衲僧家。四月十五。結他不得。七月十五。解他不得。畢竟向甚處。安身立命。師云。針鋒頭上翻筋斗。僧云。得與麼
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n2000.xml). Xutang Sayings (虛堂和尚語錄). Speaker: Xutang Zhiyu.

Senses.Explanation: The saying tells the pursuer to stop short rather than run the other person down. An unnamed interlocutor uses the line while pressing Dahui Zonggao about Mazu's direct look; Xutang Zhiyu says 'stop, stop' before using it on Shushan's entanglement, and elsewhere gives it as his answer when asked where the deceased Chengtian went.
